summary: Screened geometry/time/session-context family on output/trade_matrix.parquet (970 trades; win=dollars>0; thresholds strictly 2025 quantiles; cells n>=25/yr; pass = >=8pp WR gap or >=$60/t gap in BOTH years, same sign). TIME IS A NULL: fillhm buckets, dow, book, direction, and the pre/gold split itself all flip sign between 2025 and 2026 — winners do not cluster by clock out-of-fit (only survivor: B2 post-09:50 $-drag, $-only). The real out-of-fit structure: (1) GEOMETRY-VS-DIRECTION — entries deep on the counter-direction side of VWAP (ent_vs_vwap_sd_dir < 2025 q25) lose in both years (ALL +9.4/+18.1pp; B passes WR+$), and its twin ent_on_pos_dirloc (with-trade side of ON range) passes WR+$ in B and WR in B2; the two are spearman 0.92 (one signal); raw/abs unsigned versions are all null, so it is alignment, not distance. In gold, the EXTREME of the same signal reverses: top-quartile with-direction chase costs -$176/-$218 per trade. (2) RISK — stops <=6.75pts (2025 q25) win 17.1%/12.3% vs 28.6%/30.8%, monotone by quartile both years, independent of geometry, but WR-only ($/t does not improve with big stops). (3) OVERNIGHT-FLOW CONTEXT — fills fighting strong session CVD (bottom-quartile cvd_ON/ASIA/LON_x_dir) lose (B passes WR+$ for all three sessions; pre and gold corroborate via inventory_pts_x_dir and gap_x_dir), while plain sign-agreement binaries are null (tail effect, hump-shaped: extreme with-flow also mediocre); big one-sided/trendy overnights (abs_cvd_ON, absz_cvd_ON, abs_cvd_ASIA, eff_ON/eff_ASIA, abs gaps) hurt — modest in pre, severe for gold fills (gold cvd_ON>q75: WR 13-22%, -$165/-$334). Gold-specific extras: both London extremes swept = bad (WR+$ both years, but sign flips in pre — window-conditional), old ON extreme (>4h) = good. Category survivor: tf==2min bad in B2 (-14.9/-11.7pp; same sign ALL/pre). Caveats: many $-passes ride on large negative means (base expectancy -$45/t 2025, -$14/t 2026); pattern A untestable (2026 n=23); multiple thresholds screened per feature (q25-q75), findings quoted at their strongest passing threshold with tail/monotonicity checks run (risk monotone; VWAP-side and CVD-opposition are bottom-quartile tail effects).
